name: Roll Call
summary: Start a short roll call, let your group type /roll and see every result ranked with the winner named when time is up.
logoPrompt: Two ivory dice with gold pips tumbling above a small brass bell in the centre

cover.tagline: Who rolled highest? Now you know.
bullets: Winner shown when time is up

description: **Roll Call collects the /roll results of your group for a short time and tells you who rolled highest.**
- A small window lists every roll, highest first, with a countdown.
- Only the first roll of each player counts, so rolling again changes nothing.
- Equal rolls are marked as a tie, and rolls that are not 1-100 are shown in orange.
- The winner appears in your own chat window when time is up.

Type `/rollcall start` and ask everyone to `/roll`. The call runs 30 seconds, or pick 5 to 120 with `/rollcall start 60`. `/rollcall stop` ends it early, `/rollcall` (or `/rolls`) shows the last result.
- Works on Retail, best outside instances: there the game may hide chat lines from addons, and the window then says that rolls may be missing.
- Nothing is sent to other players.
- Reads roll lines in your client's language.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
